title: Example fieldwork data table, labelled as example data
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y11 lesson 34 (Example fieldwork data table, labelled as example data (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 34: Human fieldwork enquiry: Section B practice (Paper 2). Read it all first; an adult knows what you are doing.

practical.aim: To practise analysing fieldwork data (example data, not real measurements)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Tidy up and wash your hands
method: Read the example data in the table
Work out the mean for each site
Plot the data on squared paper
Suggest one reason and one limitation

questions.q: Big question: how would you prove one area has a better quality of life?
questions.a: Use EQS, questionnaires and secondary data at systematic sites, present and compare results, and evaluate reliability
